title: Implement: Python oracle for Regional Channel Plans
description: Write reference implementation in python/src/lichen/. Must be clear, readable, well-commented. Cover all MUST requirements.
close_reason: Completed Python oracle for Regional Channel Plans (CCP-4). Added: RegulatoryMode enum (DUTY_CYCLE/DWELL_TIME/LBT), RegulatoryRules dataclass, regulatory_rules attribute on all 7 regional plans (EU868, US915, AU915, CN470, AS923, IN865, KR920), validate_plan_id(), ch0_fallback_required(), validate_channel_mask(), is_valid_power() methods. Fixed test formula bug (n_channels vs max(n_channels-1, 2)) and default channel count (3 to 8). All 32 channel_plan tests pass, 562 core tests pass.
